architecture.code:
direction right
colorMode pastel
styleMode shadow

  Quota [label: "20 req/min/IP", icon: gauge]

Redis [label: "Upstash Redis (optional)", icon: redis, color: orange]

Client <> Backend: image up / roast JSON down
Backend <> Vision: image + rubric / roast JSON
Backend --> Redis: quota, optional
Backend --> Obs: logs, cost

request-sequence.code:
typeface clean
colorMode pastel

User [icon: user, color: blue]
UI [label: "Dropzone UI", icon: monitor, color: blue]
API [label: "/api/roast on Vercel", icon: server, color: black]
Limiter [label: "Rate limiter (optional)", icon: shield, color: orange]
AI [label: "GPT-4o vision", icon: openai, color: green]

User > UI: drop or paste screenshot
activate UI
UI > UI: check type, cap 8 MB, downscale to 1536 px
UI > API: POST multipart image
deactivate UI
activate API
API > Limiter: check IP quota
alt [label: quota exceeded] {
  Limiter > API: over limit
  API > UI: 429 + Retry-After
  UI > User: "Slow down, architect."
}
else [label: within quota] {
  API > API: verify magic bytes, cap 4 MB, base64 encode
  API > AI: image + grounded rubric (strict JSON)
  alt [label: valid roast JSON] {
    AI > API: roast, advice, fixes
    API > UI: 200 JSON, image discarded
    UI > User: typewriter reveal + one fix
  }
  else [label: timeout or 5xx after 1 retry] {
    AI > API: error
    API > UI: 502, friendly retry message
    UI > User: retry CTA, never a fake roast
  }
}
deactivate API

user-flow.code:
direction down
colorMode pastel
typeface clean

Start [label: "Upload or paste a diagram", shape: oval, icon: upload, color: blue]
Validate [label: "Check PNG/JPG, <= 8 MB, downscale", icon: check-circle]
Analyze [label: "Analyzing microservices... (rotating status)", icon: loader]
Model [label: "GPT-4o vision + strict JSON schema", icon: openai, color: green]
Reveal [label: "Typewriter roast reveal", icon: message-square, color: purple]
Advice [label: "One actionable fix", icon: wrench, color: green]
Share [label: "Copy roast / share card", icon: share, color: grey]
Error [label: "Inline error + retry CTA", icon: alert-triangle, color: red]

Start > Validate > Analyze > Model
Model > Reveal: valid JSON
Model --> Error: invalid or timeout
Reveal > Advice > Share
